{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for SEVERE disease presence
has_severe = data['severity'].isin(['severe']).any()

# Check for duplicate patient_id
n_duplicates = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()

# Check sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()

# Output findings
print(f"Has SEVERE disease: {has_severe}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {n_duplicates}")
print(f"Number of -999 sentinel values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")"}
